assumption: The read-only host dispatch-pressure node describes the pressure class used by the sampled macOS kernel; active-swapping override and customized kernel tunables are separate unknowns.
basis: Apple xnu12377 pressure conversion and reclaim policy; native warning2 produces1s and normal1 baseline produces10s on actualDarwin27.2
stress-test: normal,warning/urgent,critical,unavailable/malformed read and transitions; compare native interval brackets
falsification-probe: unchanged native controller observes a different sampling interval with stable dispatch pressure and same release profile

assumption: Embedded/closed processes must not query host state and retain the normal model policy.
basis: existing host_services boundary in sysctl/mod.rs and bounded-process tests
dependent-result: host isolation and portable model behavior
stress-test: disabled host_services with a query closure that panics if invoked
falsification-probe: a disabled-profile policy selection invokes the host query

assumption: A zero sampling period must fully trim current reclaimable bytes and never divide byzero.
basis: Apple vm_reclaim.c sampling_interval_abs==0 branch before samples_elapsed division
stress-test: nonzero last sample,current bytes and zero period; guard/cancellation paths retained
falsification-probe: panic,division-byzero,or only WMA-minimum trimming under critical policy
